body:
### Summary

When running `overlay use .venv/bin/activate.nu` in nushell, I get the following error:
```
Error: nu::shell::error

  × this command can only run during parse-time
    ╭─[/Users/matteodelton/Downloads/test/.venv/bin/activate.nu:72:24]
 71 │ 
 72 │     let virtual_env = (path self | path dirname | path dirname)
    ·                        ────┬────
    ·                            ╰── can't run after parse-time
 73 │     let bin = 'bin'
    ╰────
  help: try assigning this command's output to a const variable

```

I tried manually modifying `activate.nu`, replacing `let` with `const`, and it worked.

### Platform

macOS 27 arm64

### Version

uv 0.12.18 (Homebrew 2026-09-22 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.14.7
title: nushell's venv activation script doesn't work
